Broad flat shapes, very few interior marks. Asset: standalone creature sprite, genuinely transparent background. Gloamfang, a shaggy woodland guardian that looks like a very confused big dusty-teal cat. A crooked mustard-gold broken pendant hangs at its neck. Silly and a little suspicious. Only three large fur notches total, NO detailed fur strands or multiple claws. Entire silhouette visible, centered with generous transparent margin. Square image.
